aboutGame.title: What is Piggy?
paragraphs: Piggy is an iconic survival horror puzzle game on Roblox created by MiniToon. Trapped in eerie environments with dangerous infected foes, players must cooperate to locate colored keys, tools, and code cards to unlock barricaded exits before time runs out.

With two complete story books, an intuitive Build Mode for custom map creation, and over 200 collectible skins, our comprehensive Piggy Wiki provides chapter walkthroughs, map layouts, puzzle solutions, and lore guides to master every escape.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Piggy.

items.question: What is Piggy?
items.answer: Piggy is a viral episodic survival horror adventure on Roblox developed by MiniToon. Players take on the role of survivors navigating puzzle-filled maps to gather keys and tools, unlock barricades, and escape while avoiding an infected killer.

items.question: How do you escape maps in Piggy?
items.answer: Escaping in Piggy requires finding colored keys to unlock corresponding doors, collecting tools like hammers and wrenches to disable barricades, and dodging the monster until the main escape route opens.

items.question: How many chapters and books are there in Piggy?
items.answer: Piggy features two primary storylines: Book 1 with 12 chapters and Book 2 with 12 chapters, alongside special spinoff maps, hunt events, and custom Build Mode levels.

items.question: How do you unlock the Hidden Ending in Piggy?
items.answer: Unlocking the canon Hidden Ending in Piggy Book 2 requires obtaining all story badges across both Book 1 and Book 2, enabling the Savior Ending toggle, and completing specific puzzle triggers in Docks, Camp, and Lab.

items.question: Are there any active promo codes for Piggy?
items.answer: Piggy occasionally distributes codes during major community events or merchandise releases. Check our dedicated Piggy guides page for announcements on active code drops.
